title: Owner memory is the operating system

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: I coordinate everything through messages and memory. When I took three days away, someone revisited a customer before the part arrived, and invoices stopped because nobody knew what I promised. We have spreadsheets and calendars, but I connect them in my head.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: Six staff: owner, four technicians and administrator; plans to hire two more technicians.

discriminating_questions.question: Which commitments exist only in your head?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Call-before-visit rules, parts approvals and invoice holds.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Some decisions legitimately require the owner’s commercial judgement; do not automate every escalation or assume full delegation is desired.

discriminating_questions.question: Which decisions can staff safely make?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Routine scheduling and approved parts use, but spending limits are unwritten.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Why did the premature visit happen?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Nobody could see the pending part dependency.
discriminating_questions.diagnostic_value: Missing next-action visibility, not technician competence.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: How much implementation time is realistic?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Short daily reviews; no lengthy parallel data entry.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: Commitments, dependencies and delegated authority are person-bound rather than recorded in a shared workflow.
counterexample: Some decisions legitimately require the owner’s commercial judgement; do not automate every escalation or assume full delegation is desired.
minimum_evidence: A simulated message contains a parts promise absent from the calendar.
A simulated invoice has an owner-only hold condition.
A simulated absence review identifies repeated routine questions.
process_intervention: Create one lightweight commitment board with owner, next action and blocker; publish agreed routine decision boundaries.
automation_candidate: Capture message-derived task drafts for confirmation; remind responsible staff about dependencies; escalate exceptions beyond agreed authority.
unknowns: Actual delegation limits and which promises are binding require the owner’s review.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Commitment extraction and a formal delegation matrix require new rules and review.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
